sql: SELECT u.unit_name FROM unit_assessments a JOIN unit_assessments b ON b.unit_id = a.unit_id JOIN assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = a.unit_id JOIN states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id WHERE s.state_name = 'UTTAR PRADESH' AND a.assessment_year = '2021-2022' AND b.assessment_year = '2024-2025' AND CASE b.category WHEN 'Safe' THEN 1 WHEN 'Semi-Critical' THEN 2 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 3 WHEN 'Over-Exploited' THEN 4 END > CASE a.category WHEN 'Safe' THEN 1 WHEN 'Semi-Critical' THEN 2 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 3 WHEN 'Over-Exploited' THEN 4 END AND b.extraction_total_ham > a.extraction_total_ham * 1.10
